metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for ThreadPoolExecutor configuration with adaptive worker sizing and idle thread reuse. It differs semantically from peer ProcessPoolExecutor skills (which target CPU-bound work with process isolation) and from the generic Executor.map skill. No existing skill covers ThreadPoolExecutor-specific initialization with the min(32, os.cpu_count() + 4) default and idle worker reuse semantics. The candidate has clear support evidence from Python 3.8+ concurrent.futures documentation and addresses a different task_family (parallel_task_execution with thread_pool_configuration method) than existing skills.
